purpose: Explanation of the controlled autoresearch experiment workflow

required_facts.fact: Autoresearch delegates the experiment loop to an agent.
prepare.py is fixed and contains evaluation logic.
program.md describes agent behavior in natural language.
A baseline is recorded before experiments begin.
Each run edits, commits, executes, and evaluates train.py.
A fixed time budget keeps comparisons meaningful.
Validation bits per byte is lower-is-better in the example.
The pattern could be applied to writing style prompts.

author_attribution: The workflow is explained from Alexey's reading of Karpathy's project; no authorship of autoresearch is claimed.
